section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1993
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1993 N.C.R.R.- 54 2.5.3 Since ‘Dreadful Diseases’ (14.2%) and ‘Quarrel with Parents-in-law & Spouse’ (11.3%) were the major causes of suicidal deaths, an attempt has been made to categorise the States and UTs as high risk areas (percentage contribution exceeding the all-India average) in respect of these causes (APPENDIX-VI).
